items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: I got him one of my little friends, Albert Martin.

ctx.x: I asked him which came first.

We had some band, too. Most of our jobs called for white people. We said. We was up three years before we could play for one color people. And the first time we played for color people when Joe Oliver left from the air. You know, the thing I got in there when I was standing right by Joe Oliver with a fellow drumming him, Buddy Sali. Hit him in the eye with a wheel by the hammer. And you know, I thought Joe would be one eye, you know. And he used to have a man, Carol, all them boys. He must have been around about…
I asked you who this Bourne was. That's not Harrison Bourne.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Because we had Alfred Martin with us when I got in the band.

ctx.x: Oh, Alfred Williams, he's thinking of.

Alfred Williams. Oh no. I used to play with Alfred William. He's there. He went away there a long time. Somebody in Texas. But he come back there. He's been there ever since. I used to play with my band too. Let me see who we was playing with when he used to play with us. Sam Morgan, I bet you anything. We had a regular band. He played with Sam Morgan a long time. Sam Morgan. No, he wasn't with us when he was there. He left. He went away. Because we had Alfred Martin with us when I got in the band.
He went to California with Ari. Yeah, Alfred William. Yeah, I know he did. Let's see. Oh, bass player. You didn't tell us about the bass player.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Kid Allen and Albert Martin, he's there too.

ctx.x: Mm-hm. Kid Allen and Albert Martin, he's there too. You remember that Albedroom? Yeah. And Alex Scott. We had a band there, bass player. We had a band there. That's where, you know, left and went to Mexico, you know. And after that, when we come back, when I got a bass player, he left too. He used to wouldn't go nowhere but right up the country. He's kind of his daddy. Yeah, I remember. Tell me his son is almost as good as him now. Who, Red Allen? Huh? Who, Red Allen? Yeah. You don't know his son, eh? No, I don't…
Red Allen has been to Europe with Dude Ori.
